about_short_description.short_description: Sylndr is an automotive focused e-commerce marketplace bringing innovation to the used-cars market.

product.name: Sylndr Used-Car Marketplace
product.description: An online marketplace for browsing, comparing, financing, and purchasing used cars in Egypt, with vehicle details, pricing, inspection reports, and digital shopping tools.

product.name: Sell Your Car to Sylndr
product.description: A vehicle-selling service that lets owners submit car details online, receive a free inspection and valuation, and complete a direct sale with immediate payment and ownership-transfer support.

product.name: Sylndr Market
product.description: A managed peer-to-peer used-car marketplace where owners list inspected vehicles, receive multiple offers from verified buyers, and complete payment and ownership transfer through Sylndr.

product.name: Used-Car Financing
product.description: Online financing options for purchasing Sylndr-listed used cars, allowing buyers to submit applications digitally and select repayment plans with down payments starting from 10%.

identifier.value: Vehicle Test Drive and Delivery Services

product.name: Vehicle Test Drive and Delivery Services
product.description: Convenience services that let used-car buyers arrange a test drive at home or another suitable location and choose between hub collection and delivery to their doorstep.
